wiki.title: Mark Takano
wiki.extract: Mark Allan Takano ( tə-KAH-noh; born December 10, 1960) is an American politician and academic who has served in the United States House of Representatives since 2013, representing California's 41st congressional district from 2013 to 2023 and the 39th congressional district since 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, Takano became the first gay person of Asian descent in Congress upon taking office.

areas: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues
